baseline.method: Qualified original Eigenspectra 3PC posterior mean, author noiseless simulation with stated uncertainty

reference_kind: method posterior mean, not physical truth
observation_definition: sqrt(mean(((A*c + fitted_constant_stellar_offset - observed)/sigma)^2)); c obtained by degree-two real-harmonic projection of submitted map; only the declared nuisance stellar offset is fitted
threshold_basis: three independent original and local long chains, minimum retained length>50tau; independent replica map mean fluctuation and poor-map rejection
